title: Smith Form Equivalence for Several Classes of Multivariate Polynomial Matrices
summary: This paper investigates the equivalence reduction for several classes of multivariate polynomial matrices and their Smith forms, establishing some criteria for such reduction. In particular, we employ algebra isomorphisms as a key tool to study this equivalence problem. We then leverage the Quillen-Suslin and Lin-Bose theorems to extend these results to non-square and rank-deficient matrices. Moreover, the verification of our criteria is achievable algorithmically via existing Gröbner basis methods.
